title: Actions, not keys
description:
Map keys and buttons to game actions, with rebinding.

```
jump: SPACE or W or gamepad A
pressed SPACE -> jump
rebind jump to UP -> SPACE does nothing now, UP jumps
two actions on one key refused
```
hints: The game code asks `active.count(Action::jump)` and never mentions keys, so rebinding changes nothing else (lesson 1.05).
In raylib, `IsKeyDown(KEY_SPACE)` and `IsGamepadButtonDown(0, GAMEPAD_BUTTON_RIGHT_FACE_DOWN)` produce the held list.
requirements: An `enum class Action` and a map from input names to actions.
`actionsFor(heldInputs)` returns the set of active actions.
Rebinding refuses a key already used by another action, and saves to a text line per action.
stretch: Separate "pressed this frame" from "held" for actions like jump.
